title: DeepOxygen Raises Multi-Million RMB Angel from Hanergy for AIGC 3D Video Engine
summary: AIGC engine vendor DeepOxygen (深氧科技) raised multi-million RMB angel from Hanergy Ventures. Proceeds: product iteration, GTM, tech hiring.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · February 14, 2023

AIGC engine vendor DeepOxygen (深氧科技) raised multi-million RMB angel from Hanergy Ventures. Proceeds: product iteration, GTM, tech hiring.

Zhou Hongyi (360) to Zhang Chaoyang (Sohu) Feb 9: ChatGPT may start a new industrial revolution — miss the train and get left behind. ChatGPT (OpenAI, Nov 2022 on GPT-3.5) hit 100M MAU by end-Jan 2023; CB Insights shows AIGC financing rising since Microsoft’s $1B OpenAI (2019) with power-law concentration.

DeepOxygen (2022) ships cloud-native 3D creation via mobile/web for zero-skill users → native 3D → video → short-video platforms. O3.xyz V1.0 live: text → 3D video end-to-end; Director GPT (ChatGPT vertical) retrieves/calls/edits 3D assets from description.

— END —
